end.summary:
Practised Bishnoi, sacred groves, and the Chipko movement.
Identified that roots hold soil and help stop rain from washing it away.
Explained that sacred groves are forest areas left undisturbed.
Discussed ways ordinary people can protect nature, but the government-only idea remained at the end.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Dev practised examples of traditional nature protection and explained how roots protect soil. They correctly connected the Bishnoi and Chipko examples with protecting trees, and later explained sacred groves clearly. Dev still mixed up whether ordinary people can make a difference, and this was not fully corrected by the last response. At home, ask Dev to name one small action people can take to protect a nearby tree, plant, animal, or water source.
